title: Register Modulation: Shifting between Formal (Ön) and Informal (Te)

sections.title: Navigating Social Politeness
sections.content: You know *Ön* (A1 Unit 25), polite *tetszik* (A2 Unit 37) and *te / ti* (A1 Unit 1). Mastering Hungarian also means choosing between them: shifting naturally between formal 3rd-person address (*Ön / Maga* with formal verb agreements) in administrative and business environments, and informal 2nd-person address (*te / ti*) among friends and colleagues.

items.english: We can address each other informally, if you don't mind.
